description: The bridge between the private Forgejo and GitHub: whether it is working, whether polls succeed, what is queued or stuck, and what it wrote on either side.

panels.description: The running version. Two values here means a rollout is in progress, or a second replica is waiting.
panels.title: Build

panels.description: Instances holding the leader lock and doing the work. Exactly 1 is right; 0 means nothing crosses the bridge.
panels.title: Active

panels.description: Issues and pull requests waiting to be reconciled. Briefly above zero after every poll that saw a change.
panels.title: Queued

panels.description: Queued resources whose last reconcile failed. A merge waiting for the push mirror counts for a minute; anything longer is stuck. The log line "reconcile failed" says why.
panels.title: Failing

panels.description: How long the longest-waiting resource has been queued.
panels.title: Oldest wait

panels.description: Time since the least recent successful poll across the selected repositories and both sides. It should stay around the poll interval.
panels.title: Since last poll

panels.description: Requests left in GitHub's current rate-limit window. Unchanged lists are answered from their ETag and cost nothing.
panels.title: GitHub budget

panels.description: A sawtooth with the poll interval as its height is healthy. A line that keeps rising is a side that cannot be polled; the log says "poll failed" with the reason.
panels.title: Time since last successful poll

targets.expr: time() - max by (repository, side) (forgejo_github_bridge_last_successful_poll_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", repository=~"$repository"})

panels.description: Polls that failed: a forge unreachable, a token rejected, the rate limit exhausted. Retried at the next interval.
panels.title: Poll errors

panels.description: One poll of one side of one repository: two list requests, more pages when much changed.
panels.title: Poll duration (p95)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (repository, side, le) (rate(forgejo_github_bridge_poll_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", repository=~"$repository"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Both on one axis: failing is part of queued. Queued spikes and returns to zero; failing that stays up is something stuck.
panels.title: Queue

panels.description: Grows while something waits. Backoff tops out at 30 minutes, so a line well past that is a resource failing on every attempt.
panels.title: Oldest wait

panels.description: poll is changes seen on either forge; resync is the periodic pass over every open pair, which is what notices deletions.
panels.title: Marked dirty

panels.description: error includes waiting for the push mirror after a merge, which is expected and brief. Sustained errors show in Failing above.
panels.title: Reconciles by outcome

panels.description: Everything the bridge wrote on GitHub: issues published, comments projected, notices, closes. A write without a matching change on the other side would be a loop.
panels.title: Writes to GitHub

targets.expr: sum by (kind, action) (rate(forgejo_github_bridge_changes_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", repository=~"$repository", side="github"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Everything the bridge wrote in Forgejo: imported issues and pull requests, pushed commits, labels, comments.
panels.title: Writes to Forgejo

targets.expr: sum by (kind, action) (rate(forgejo_github_bridge_changes_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", repository=~"$repository", side="forgejo"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: GitHub issues imported into Forgejo in the selected time range.

targets.expr: (sum(sum by (side) (increase(forgejo_github_bridge_changes_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", repository=~"$repository", side="forgejo", kind="issue", action="create"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Issues imported

panels.description: Forgejo issues published to GitHub with the publish label, in the selected time range.

targets.expr: (sum(sum by (side) (increase(forgejo_github_bridge_changes_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", repository=~"$repository", side="github", kind="issue", action="create"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Issues published

targets.expr: (sum(sum by (side) (increase(forgejo_github_bridge_changes_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", repository=~"$repository", kind="pull", action="create"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Pushes of new contributor commits into contrib branches.

targets.expr: (sum(sum by (side) (increase(forgejo_github_bridge_changes_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", repository=~"$repository", kind="pull", action="push"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Commits followed

panels.description: Imported pull requests that change CI configuration. Each needs a careful read before its workflow run is approved.

targets.expr: (sum(sum by (side) (increase(forgejo_github_bridge_changes_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", repository=~"$repository", kind="pull", action="touches-ci"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Touching CI

targets.expr: (sum(sum by (side) (increase(forgejo_github_bridge_changes_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", repository=~"$repository", kind="comment", action="create"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

panels.description: GitHub gives an App installation at least 5000 requests an hour. The budget refills every hour; a steady descent towards zero means polling too often or too many repositories for one installation.
panels.title: Rate-limit budget

panels.description: Every rate-limit window GitHub reported for the installation: core is the REST API the bridge uses. Other windows appear only once a response named them.
panels.title: Budget by window

panels.description: When GitHub starts the core window over and the budget is full again. Negative for a moment when no response has arrived since the window ended.
panels.title: Core window resets in

panels.description: The active instance vacuums and analyzes every table once per interval. The first line should stay under the second; one that keeps rising past it is a round that does not happen. No interval line: maintenance is off.
panels.title: Since the last maintenance round

panels.description: How long the last round of the active instance took. Seconds for the bridge's small tables.
panels.title: Last round took

panels.description: Rounds in the selected range in which a table or index could not be kept. The log line "database maintenance round done" names what failed.
panels.title: Failed rounds

panels.description: Browsers following the console's event stream, on all instances.
panels.title: Watching live

title: Forgejo GitHub Bridge
